page_title: ATM 2-0 VAL | Atletico Madrid v Valencia 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Valencia are ruled offside.
90+2' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Ruben Baraja decides to make a substitution. Hugo Duro will be replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Lopez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia).
89' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' 8:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
86' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
84' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' The referee shows the yellow card to Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
81' A substitution has been made. Pablo Barrios goes off and Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
79' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) replaces Gabriel Paulista.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Hugo Guillamon.
77' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
75' Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
73' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
72' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Atl. Madrid using VAR. Let's see what happens.

71' Jose Gaya (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea no option but to blow his whistle. PENALTY AWARDED to Atl. Madrid!
71' Valencia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
69' The attendance for today's match is 59493.
67' Substitution. Rodrigo de Paul makes way for Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
67' Here is a change. Memphis Depay is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid).
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Samuel Lino will be replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
64' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Diego Lopez (Valencia).

62' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea with no other option than to blow for a foul.
59' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Jose Maria Gimenez is replaced by Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
57' 2 - 0 Goal! A great cross from Nahuel Molina finds Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid), who scores with a simple header into an empty net. 2:0.
55' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Roman Yaremchuk (Valencia) will replace Fran Perez.
54' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

53' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Giorgi Mamardashvili displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
51' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Jose Gaya (Valencia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' The game has begun to heat up. Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' 1 - 0 Goal! Antoine Griezmann puts a cross into the box and finds Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid), who latches on to it and strikes the ball low into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:0.
45+5' The free kick from long range, taken by Valencia, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
45+4' Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
45+2' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
42' Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
37' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea signals NO PENALTY for Valencia after a VAR review!
36' Referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
36' That looked a certain handball by Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
36' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing.
35' Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

33' The opposition back off Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili denies him with the save.

33' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
30' The number of shots on goal at present is 4:0.
27' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
25' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili.
23' Atl. Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
23' The ball is cleared after Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

21' Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
19' Hugo Duro (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Giorgi Mamardashvili.
15' An attempted cross from Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
13' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Koke (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
11' Jose Gaya (Valencia) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
9' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
8' The players claim that Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
5' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
4' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) heads on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Valencia will kick the game off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea will officiate today.
